LPI can be used to discover the geometric and discriminated structures of the document data space, which is more effective than LSI and NMF in clustering documents into semantic classes.
the LPI-based document clustering method can be used for clustering of high-dimensional document space and it outperforms other methods in both accuracy and speed.
our method is able to cluster the documents effectively and efficiently.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two main issues: (i) how to discover the geometric structures of the document semantic space, (ii) how to discover discriminant structures of the document clusters in the semantic space.

the LPI-based clustering algorithm performs very well in comparison to the other clustering methods.
our method performs significantly better than other existing clustering methods.
our LPI clustering algorithm is superior to the state-of-the-art document clustering methods in the sense that it is able to achieve higher precision, recall, F-measure and accuracy.

the proposed method is a promising approach for document clustering and can outperform other state-of-the-art clustering algorithms.
our method is more effective than other state-of-the-art methods for document clustering.
our method is more efficient than LSI or NMF, and achieves better clustering performance in most cases.

LPI is able to achieve a comparable clustering performance to LSI and NMF in terms of clustering accuracy, while it has the advantage of lower computational complexity.
